root_causes_addressed.issue: Wrong TigerGraph vector query: Qwen 1024-d query vector compared against legacy v.embedding at 1536-d, causing GSQL-90000.
root_causes_addressed.resolution: Updated retrieve_similar_with_score in tigergraph_embedding_store.py to check for 1024-dimensional query vectors and route to GraphRAG_Hybrid_Qwen_Vector_Search operating on v.qwen_embedding (1024-d).

root_causes_addressed.issue: Legacy 1536-dim fallback in embedding_services.py overriding Qwen 1024 config.
root_causes_addressed.resolution: Updated EmbeddingModel.__init__ to resolve explicit output_dimensionality first and default to 1024 for Qwen/standard embeddings, while preserving explicit 1536 on GenAI_Embedding.

root_causes_addressed.issue: Swallowed vector retrieval errors turning GSQL execution failures into empty results [].
root_causes_addressed.resolution: Updated retrieve_similar_with_score to raise explicit RuntimeError upon GSQL/vector query execution failures.

root_causes_addressed.issue: Stale evaluator code in live Docker container because benchmark/ directory was not mounted.
root_causes_addressed.resolution: Added ./benchmark/:/code/benchmark volume mount to graphrag service in docker-compose.yml.
